title.rendered: Dinner Night Out!  Handel’s Ice Cream

content.rendered: Our next Dinner (Dessert!) Night Out is on Thursday, June 6th, 11:00am-10:00pm. Present the flyer, or show a picture of it on your smartphone during your purchase and 25% of the profit will come back to Hawks View Elementary. What an easy and tasty way to help raise money for our school! Handel’s is located at 21300 SW Langer Farms Pkwy.
